headline: Six therapies. [[Short on purpose.]]
note: Every therapy is prescribed for one named patient after a licensed clinician's evaluation, and compounded by a licensed U.S. pharmacy.

headline: If a physician wouldn't prescribe it, [[it's not on our menu.]]
note: None of these has completed FDA's process to be lawfully compounded. An advisory vote is not an approval.

headline: Popular in gyms. [[Barely studied in people.]]
